scope: Read-only gate/helper/schema review plus supporting deterministic tests and final preflight replay-result comparison. This is not a completed V2 arm gate, source acceptance or blanket native qualification. No model calls or production/source edits. Separate prelaunch plan-binding review remains required.

supporting_tests.limit: Tests exercise detail grading/manual binding and exact restored consumers. Full five-sample arm verification cannot run before the cohort exists.

closed_source_issue.issue: Registration plans could be empty/subset, leaving selected plan not bound to registration.
closed_source_issue.resolution: Exact unique two-path registration list, SHA256 format, current file hashes and selected-plan registered hash are now mandatory. Required frozen dependencies plus runner/harness/fixture/dependency identities and sample arm/policy are enforced.

reviewed_gates: Exactly five V2 sample names and exact arm/policy plus manual plan/sample-set bindings.
Complete mandatory frozen helper/import/source/context entries and final unchanged-input hashes.
Manifest runtime root/commit, policy, fixture, dependency, harness and task hashes; runtime artifact integrity.
Worker exit, plan/runner/model/effort/arm and exact native metadata/evidence-key hashes.
Actual raw native session hash and exact auditor replay against the same source policy.
Fresh V2 grade equals stored raw report and workflow replay; original legacy exact-projection diagnostics remain present.
Manual case/decision completeness and exact source/ledger/events/consumer hashes with explicit authority/facts/no-unsupported-assertion statuses.

Every optional detail claim has exact value/hash, explicit passing independent judgement, source pointers and rationale; code verifies citations exist without pretending citations prove interpretation.
Restored real consumer replay must pass, then all guarded source/sample/native/manual inputs must remain unchanged.

final_preflight_confirmation.allowed_difference: Parsed runcheck.stdout.run_dir only. All other fields/consumer stdout/stderr/exit/error and full persisted summary compare exactly.

external_requirements: Independent review of final registration/plan hashes, exact two operator context paths and all frozen inputs before launch.
Record the complete five-baseline native/raw/manual/detail/consumer gate before any candidate launch; this verifier does not launch or enforce chronology of external invocations.
Candidate needs the same complete independent five-sample gate.
Keep original V1 hold, failures and diagnostics unchanged; fresh V2 cohort is separate and unpooled.
Source integration, installed-source checks and accounting remain separate after both arms qualify.
